newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude fell to $18.39 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude fell to $18.39 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude fell to an average of $18.39 per barrel on August 26, down from the $18.49 the day before, a spokesman for state-run Petroecuador said Friday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The price average in July was $17.46 per barrel, while in July 1995 was $14.13 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
